title: authoring gate: an app navigation `visible` over the CEL size budget passes save and draft diagnostics, where a page visibleWhen of the same size is refused
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① product defect with reach, a class (a) out-of-scope finding of the #28663 dev (os-dev-report 6560034536), measured on a stock showcase boot. Graded by this seat: p3 (the console effect is inferred from the shared CEL limits, not measured in a browser), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: an author saving an app through the metadata door or Studio.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts`, which #28663's PR #28723 extends to app `navigation[].visible`).

## What happens

Measured by the #28663 dev on a stock showcase boot: an app nav `visible` holding a 90-clause `||` chain (valid CEL, over `maxAstNodes`) gives draft `_diagnostics` `valid: true`. The page-side twin is already refused as `visibility-predicate-over-budget`. Inferred, not measured: the console's evaluator applies the same CEL limits, so the entry would be withheld from every viewer, as a syntax error was before #28663.

## Wanted

- First measure the console effect once (does the entry disappear?). If it does, run the existing `visibility-predicate-over-budget` judgment over app `navigation[].visible` and `areas[].navigation[].visible`, at the surfaces #28663 makes the syntax judgment run on. One rule, more paths.
- If the console evaluates it fine, close this card with that reading.
- `Clause-②: no` (a narrowing; contract review owed), `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`.

## Business reason

Same as #28663: an author must not be able to save a navigation entry that silently disappears for everyone.

Blocked-by: #28663

Dedupe: searched `navigation visible maxAstNodes OR "over-budget"` (183 hits); on topic only #28663 and #24450 (closed, a different rule).
